# Filter out rows that are not actual seasons (like "Totals:" and "No Team" and "Upcoming")
df_valid = df[~df['Season'].astype(str).str.contains('Totals|No Team|Upcoming', na=False)]

# Convert 'Total Wins' to numeric, coerce errors to NaN
df_valid['Total Wins'] = pd.to_numeric(df_valid['Total Wins'], errors='coerce')

# Find the row(s) with the maximum total wins
max_wins = df_valid['Total Wins'].max()
max_seasons = df_valid[df_valid['Total Wins'] == max_wins]['Season'].tolist()

# If there are multiple seasons with the same max wins, return all as a list
answer = max_seasons if len(max_seasons) > 1 else max_seasons[0]
